correctness.rationale: FARL-to-monadic follows from published FARL17/FARL18, FARL4, FARL1, and Gödel idempotence for M5. Monadic-to-FARL follows from the established common-image lower/upper approximation theorem for monadic Gödel algebras, which yields the Galois adjunction and fixed-image Frobenius identities. On finite chains the common image is any endpoint-containing subchain, giving the stated rounding formulas and count. Exhaustive replay checks both axiom systems separately on small chains and on a non-chain four-element Gödel algebra.

value.rationale: The 2026 paper emphasizes that FARL and monadic residuated lattices are distinct and incomparable. Gödel algebras form a major, logically natural class where the two semantics unexpectedly collapse, locating a clean boundary of the distinction. The finite-chain corollary gives an exact and reproducible model-space baseline for the new Frobenius-Galois logic on Gödel chains.
